name: Torrelameu (Spain)
description: Orange-red field charged at the centre with a yellow turreted tower between two white Maltese crosses.
history: The official flag of Torrelameu is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the yellow turreted tower with red door and windows of the arms, 2/3 of the height and 2/7 of the length of the cloth, at the centre, and with the two Maltese crosses; approved on 10 April 2018 and published in the DOGC on 13 April 2018.

features.role: turreted tower with red door and windows
two Maltese crosses flanking the tower
